versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ifly-hyper-tts, providing text-to-speech (TTS) using iFlytek’s hyper-realistic voice synthesis API.
- Supports text input, custom voice selection (VCN), speed, volume, pitch, and output format (MP3 and others).
- Includes a curated pool of 7 default voices across Mandarin, English, and Chinese dialects.
- Offers detailed user instructions, error code explanations, and environment variable configuration guidance.
- Documentation includes example usage, API parameter details, workflow, and troubleshooting tips.
